@graph.name: MarkLayer
@graph.description: Free webpage, PDF and image annotation and visual collaboration tool. Draw, comment and mark up any live website, PDF or image, then share a link for instant feedback.

@graph.name: MarkLayer
@graph.description: Free, anonymous web app for annotating any live webpage, PDF or image. Paste a URL on marklayer.app or drop in a file, then draw, comment or highlight in your browser. No install, no account, no sign-up. Share a single link for instant visual feedback.
@graph.disambiguatingDescription: MarkLayer is a browser-based web app: you paste a URL at marklayer.app and annotate the live page in your browser. It is not a browser extension and there is nothing to download or install to use it, for you or for anyone you share a link with. A separate free Chrome extension exists as an optional companion for pages the web app cannot embed, such as sites behind a login, but it is not required to annotate, to share, or to view a shared annotation.
@graph.applicationSubCategory: Visual Feedback, PDF and Image Annotation
@graph.operatingSystem: Any web browser (no installation or extension required)
featureList: Runs in the browser at marklayer.app. No download, no installation, no browser extension needed
Optional free Chrome extension for in-place annotation on sites behind a login or with strict embed policies
100% free. No paid plan, no trial, no per-seat pricing
Anonymous by default. No account, email or sign-up required
Share annotations via a single link. Viewers need no extension and no account
Drawing, comments, arrows, highlights, area capture, element inspector, measure tool
Annotate PDFs and images by link or by uploading a file up to 25MB, with selectable PDF text and marks bound to a page
MCP server (marklayer-mcp) for AI coding agent integration
Open source and self-hostable on Cloudflare

@graph.name: MarkLayer Chrome Extension
@graph.description: Free Chrome extension companion to the MarkLayer web app. Use it to annotate pages the web app cannot embed, such as sites behind a login or with strict embed policies.
@graph.disambiguatingDescription: An optional companion to the MarkLayer web app, not the primary way to use MarkLayer. Annotating and viewing shared annotations both work with no extension installed.

@graph.name: How to annotate any webpage with MarkLayer
@graph.description: Free and anonymous workflow for adding drawings, comments, arrows, and highlights to any live webpage and sharing them via a link. No install required for most sites.

step.name: Paste a URL on marklayer.app
step.text: Open marklayer.app and paste any URL into the annotation field. No install, no account, no sign-up. (For sites the web app cannot embed, install the optional free Chrome extension.)

step.name: Draw, comment, or highlight
step.text: Use the floating toolbar to draw freehand, add shapes or arrows, pin comments, or highlight elements directly on the live page.

step.name: Collaborate in real time
step.text: Invite others via the share link. Unlimited collaborators can annotate the same page together with live cursors and optional voice chat.

step.name: Share the link
step.text: Click Share to copy a single link. Send it to anyone. They can open it in any browser, no install or account required.
